name: APT Packaging Limited
about: APT Packaging Limited manufactures and sells co-extruded tubes and related activities in India and internationally. The company offers decoration products, such as label tube, offset printing, screen printing, and hot foiling. It also offers packaging tubes in various types of diameters, layers, and colors; and tamper-proof sealing packaging. In addition, it offers polyethylene and polypropylene tubes, master batches, labels, caps, laminates, lacquer, and other packaging consumables. The company was formerly known as Anil Chemicals and Industries Limited and changed its name to APT Packaging Limited in June 2008. APT Packaging Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Aurangabad, India.
